verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents full-text search over Threads by keyword across sender, recipients, subject, and body, with results ranked by relevance. That covers the ranked-results and field-coverage parts of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows search operators, search filters, speed claims, or explicit coverage of the full mail history. Missing for 10: query operators/syntax, search filters (e.g. by label, date, or inbox), evidence of search speed, confirmation that it covers the full history, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
